name: Witherbark Medicine Pouch
summary: A Witherbark Medicine Pouch is carried by the witch doctors of Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands. Apprentice Kryten seeks several for Archmage Malin’s research.

sections.title: A Witch Doctor’s Pouch
sections.body: At Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands, the witch doctors carry medicine pouches. Apprentice Kryten needs four of them, along with Witherbark tusks and a Shadow Hunter Knife, for Archmage Malin.

faq.answer: Apprentice Kryten at Refuge Pointe needs four Witherbark Medicine Pouches for Archmage Malin’s research.

faq.q: Where do the pouches come from?
faq.answer: Witherbark Witch Doctors at Witherbark Village in the Arathi Highlands carry the medicine pouches.

faq.q: How many pouches does Kryten need?
faq.answer: Kryten needs four Witherbark Medicine Pouches.
Kryten also seeks ten Witherbark Tusks and a Shadow Hunter Knife for Archmage Malin.
